description: Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) already covers package.json and the
GitHub Actions used in the workflows. This file exists for the one vendored
library Dependabot cannot see: lightning-flow-scanner-core is built from a
GitHub tag because the npm package lags far behind (6.0.4 against 6.19.3
upstream), so its version lives in vendors.json instead of package.json.
Renovate is only needed if the project adopts it; nothing breaks without it.

customManagers.description: Track the lightning-flow-scanner-core version pinned in vendors.json

packageRules.description: A version bump here is not enough on its own: the committed artifact has to be rebuilt and its checksum updated, or `npm run sync-vendors -- --check` will fail in CI.
prBodyNotes: After merging, run `npm run build-flow-scanner <version>` and `npm run sync-vendors -- --sbom`, then commit `addon/lib/flow-scanner-core.js`, `vendors.json` and `vendored.cdx.json`.

packageRules.description: The vendored npm libraries are committed into addon/ as build output, so a version bump must be followed by a re-sync.
prBodyNotes: After merging, run `npm run sync-vendors` and commit the regenerated files under `addon/`.
